test_summaries.test_name: Exact repeatability of the controlled-planning path
test_summaries.purpose: Verify that COMP-001 produces the same governed decision when the same evidence and context are executed repeatedly.
test_summaries.conclusion: The stable governed decision remained identical across repeated executions.

test_summaries.test_name: Exact repeatability of the constrained-execution path
test_summaries.purpose: Verify that PUMP-001 remains stable when the same high-risk but resource-constrained case is repeated.
test_summaries.conclusion: The stable governed decision remained identical across repeated executions.

test_summaries.test_name: Exact repeatability of the diagnostic-review path
test_summaries.purpose: Verify that DATA-001 repeatedly blocks normal execution and preserves diagnostic review when evidence quality is poor.
test_summaries.conclusion: The stable governed decision remained identical across repeated executions.

test_summaries.test_name: Same asset family with different compressor contexts
test_summaries.purpose: Compare compressor scenarios to verify that the same broad failure family can produce adapted decisions when urgency, resources or context differ.
test_summaries.conclusion: Different scenarios in the same broad family produced differentiated governed decisions.

test_summaries.purpose: Compare cases where risk exists but resource or specialist availability changes the execution mode.
test_summaries.conclusion: At least one resource-constrained case preserved risk while blocking normal execution.

test_summaries.purpose: Verify that questionable or contradictory evidence leads to diagnostic review rather than blind execution.
test_summaries.conclusion: Evidence-quality cases produced diagnostic-review behaviour instead of blind execution.

test_summaries.purpose: Execute the full scenario library once to provide the overall benchmark baseline.
test_summaries.conclusion: All 20 scenarios executed and generated the expected evidence chain.
